scope: four independent truth layers and annotation blinding invariants
common_rules: algorithm predictions are hidden from every truth annotation pass
unresolved evidence remains unresolved and is never coerced to a negative label
raw annotator labels, disagreement indicators and adjudicated labels are retained
all sampled double-annotation disagreements are adjudicated before model scoring
no numerical agreement threshold is used to discard a truth layer or retune an observer
cross-layer conflicts are retained and never automatically reconciled

biological_truth_annotation.event_rule: visit_event truth carries a stable event_id; non-visit and unresolved truth do not
biological_truth_annotation.unresolved_rule: if the reference stream cannot resolve the biological state, label unresolved rather than no_insect

coupling_truth_annotation.input: reference stream sufficient to assess whether local focal-target response was caused by the insect interaction
coupling_truth_annotation.positive_rule: present requires independently adjudicated biological truth of target_contact or visit_event
coupling_truth_annotation.attribution_rule: if causal attribution to the insect is not supportable, label unresolved rather than present
coupling_truth_annotation.consistency_use: the completed biological ledger may be used only for the logical positive-coupling consistency check

nuisance_truth_annotation.input: primary system-under-test stream plus physical nuisance logs when available
nuisance_truth_annotation.hard_rule: target-driven local response is excluded from exogenous nuisance truth and belongs to the coupling layer when causally supported
nuisance_truth_annotation.cause_rule: optional physical cause descriptions do not replace the finite process-effect labels

support_truth_annotation.input: primary system-under-test stream plus geometry, timing and photometric metadata needed for the five support requirements
overall_rule: any failed necessary component => resolved UNOBSERVABLE
else any unresolved component => overall support truth unresolved
else any compromised component => resolved COMPROMISED
else five adequate components => resolved OBSERVABLE
support_truth_annotation.counterfactual_question: if a focal visit opportunity occurred, did the primary stream preserve enough measurement support to attempt the operational visit inference
hard_rules: low target evidence is not proof of poor support
known biological presence is not proof that support was adequate
support is not defined as one minus nuisance

keys: reference clip SHA-256 for biological/coupling ledgers
primary clip SHA-256 for nuisance/support ledgers
ledger_join.order: each layer is annotated and internally adjudicated before the ledgers are joined

double_annotation.selection_rule: at least 20 percent within each truth layer and realised independent block are selected by a protected probability or deterministic hash sample fixed before model scoring
double_annotation.disagreement_rule: all selected disagreements are adjudicated before scoring while raw labels and disagreement remain retained
double_annotation.agreement_reporting: descriptive agreement is reported by layer; there is no post-result agreement threshold for dropping a layer

frozen_here: minimum double-annotation fraction and disagreement handling
not_frozen_here: final cluster count or split proportion
split_blinding_boundary.reason: those realised allocation choices depend on the still-unfrozen sampling/power plan and dataset manifest

held_out_change_control: these four truth definitions and blinding invariants cannot be changed after held-out model outputs are inspected
